title: PCIFEvaluationDatasetSchema
description: Formal schema for synthetic evaluation scenarios in the Patient Context Intelligence Framework (PCIF). Used for evaluating multi-source contextual assistance against current consultation baseline.

split.description: Dataset split. 'pilot' is for debugging evaluation tooling; 'final' is locked for frozen comparative evaluation.

difficulty.description: Contextual reasoning complexity level (easy: small obvious facts; medium: multiple facts with distractors; hard: temporal shifts, cross-source provenance, conflicts).

text.description: Transient clinician-entered consultation text (SOURCE A). Not a doctor-confirmed diagnosis.

fact_units.description: Evaluation-only fact units for the current consultation (Q1, Q2, etc.). Never injected into model prompts.

patient_reported_current_context.description: Active patient-reported context items (SOURCE B active profile). Compatible with CCEE schema + evaluation fact_id.

patient_reported_longitudinal_history.description: Prior patient-reported context observations (SOURCE B longitudinal history).

clinician_authored_history.description: Clinician-authored historical notes (SOURCE C). Explicitly authored notes with doctor_confirmed provenance.

relevant_fact_ids.description: List of historical fact IDs (F1, F2...) that are clinically/contextually relevant to the current consultation.

irrelevant_fact_ids.description: List of historical distractor fact IDs (F1, F2...) that should not be prioritized or surfaced as relevant context.

conflict_groups.description: Explicit conflicting evidence groups to be surfaced for clinician verification (may include Q and F fact IDs).

expected_provenance.description: Mapping from fact_id to expected provenance classification ('current_consultation', 'patient_reported', or 'clinician_authored').

notes_for_evaluator.description: Optional evaluator guidelines, scenario context rationale, or test notes.

fact_id.description: Evaluation-only fact identifier within the current consultation (e.g., Q1, Q2).

text.description: Atomic factual statement or mention within the current consultation text.

fact_id.description: Stable local fact identifier within the historical context (e.g., F1, F2).

category.description: Clinical context category from the 11 frozen CCEE categories.

summary.description: Compressed clinical summary of the patient-reported observation.

record_type.description: Verification classification; strictly 'patient_reported' for patient interactions.

value.description: Optional quantitative or qualitative metric (e.g., '5 hours/night').

duration.description: Optional reported duration or timeframe (e.g., '1 week').

fact_id.description: Stable local fact identifier within the historical context (e.g., F1, F2).

category.description: Clinical context category from the 11 frozen CCEE categories.

summary.description: Compressed clinical summary of the prior observation.

status.description: Optional dataset-only longitudinal status annotation (does not alter runtime CCEE schema).

observed_period.description: Optional dataset-only temporal marker (e.g., '2 weeks ago', 'prior baseline').

fact_id.description: Stable local fact identifier within the historical context (e.g., F1, F2).

conflict_id.description: Identifier for the conflict group (e.g., C1, C2).

fact_ids.description: Fact IDs (Q and/or F IDs) involved in this discrepancy/conflict.

expected_behavior.description: Expected AI system behavior; must preserve all facts and surface discrepancy for verification.

description.description: Optional evaluator description of the discrepancy.
